representativeTask.title: Hermes agent: implement and verify a code edit
representativeTask.description: The pinned Hermes-Agent runtime (Nous Research, revision 77e2992020eafded09e0c344e687ae53e52e6eab) solves a real coding task headless — implementing a documented function through its file and terminal tools, running the verification itself — with Zeck as its sole AI execution authority: every model turn (the agent loop and the automatic session-title auxiliary call) is a real Zeck execution dispatched through the multi-surface delegation boundary (text, vision, speech, transcription and image surfaces are all certified on the same boundary).

reproducibility.instructions: Build the pinned runtime: git clone https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git && git -C hermes-agent checkout 77e2992020eafded09e0c344e687ae53e52e6eab && uv venv /home/z/my-project/.venv-hermes --python 3.14.7 && uv pip install --python /home/z/my-project/.venv-hermes/bin/python -e ./hermes-agent. Then run the battery: bun run compat/hermes-agent/harness/run-battery.ts (resumable; every step checkpoints to /tmp/ppr-022-battery/battery-state.json). The battery requires the sandbox's authorized GLM supply config (/etc/.z-ai-config) — platform-side BYOK material, never present in the Hermes runtime.
